verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents per-project event quotas, rate limits, or spend caps. The pricing items only state plan allowances (5K occurrences, 5K free events per month), and the token-disabling and data-retention docs are adjacent controls that do not cap ingestion or billing.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice
